enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Remain still. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down slightly. Adjust pillow again. Turn to right side again. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Comb hair. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Take bowl to sink. Rinse bowl. Put bowl in dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to mirror. Check appearance. Pick up phone. Check messages. Pick up bag. Put laptop in bag. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Take out phone. Check emails. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord to signal stop. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write report. Organize files. Print documents. Attend another meeting. Update program database.

Stand up from desk. Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Bite apple. Drink water. Throw away trash. Wipe table. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Check phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Continue working on computer. Open project file. Edit document. Save file. Make phone call. Speak to colleague. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Send email. Organize desk. File documents. Review budget. Update spreadsheet. Print report. Attend another meeting. Discuss program details. Return to desk. Check emails. Log out of computer.

Stand up from desk. Pack bag. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Take out phone. Check messages. Stand up. Pull cord to signal stop. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Add chicken to pan. Stir chicken. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Take plate to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put phone down. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Open online shopping site. Browse products. Add item to cart. Checkout. Enter payment info. Confirm order. Close browser. Open document. Write journal. Save document. Close document. Shut down computer. Close laptop.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly.
